mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.version_id AS versionId, tc.cycle_no AS cycleNo, tc.cycle_name AS cycleName, tc.cycle_stage AS cycleStage, tc.environment_id AS environmentId, tc.code_version AS codeVersion, tc.git_branch AS gitBranch, tc.git_commit AS gitCommit, tc.build_no AS buildNo, tc.status, tc.started_at AS startedAt, tc.completed_at AS completedAt, tc.created_at AS createdAt, v.version_no AS versionNo, p.project_code AS projectCode, p.project_name AS projectName, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentCode')), e.environment_code) AS environmentCode, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentName')), e.environment_name) AS environmentName, IFNULL(stats.caseCount, 0) AS caseCount, IFNULL(stats.passCount, 0) AS passCount, IFNULL(stats.failCount, 0) AS failCount, IFNULL(stats.blockedCount, 0) AS blockedCount, IFNULL(stats.skippedCount, 0) AS skippedCount, IFNULL(stats.notRunCount, 0) AS notRunCount

FROM dpm_test_cycle tc INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = tc.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id INNER JOIN dpm_environment e ON e.id = tc.environment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cycle_id, COUNT(1) AS caseCount, SUM(latest_result = 'PASS') AS passCount, SUM(latest_result = 'FAIL') AS failCount, SUM(latest_result = 'BLOCKED') AS blockedCount, SUM(latest_result = 'SKIPPED') AS skippedCount, SUM(latest_result = 'NOT_RUN') AS notRunCount FROM dpm_cycle_case GROUP BY cycle_id ) stats ON stats.cycle_id = tc.id

where.if: AND (tc.cycle_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.code_version LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.version_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_test_cycle tc INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = tc.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id

SELECT , CAST(tc.environment_snapshot AS CHAR) AS environmentSnapshotJson, CAST(tc.scope_json AS CHAR) AS scopeJson, tc.description, tc.created_by AS createdBy
WHERE tc.id = #{id}
SELECT id, version_id AS versionId, status FROM dpm_test_cycle WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM dpm_version WHERE id = #{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, environment_code AS environmentCode, environment_name AS environmentName, environment_type AS environmentType, base_url AS baseUrl, api_base_url AS apiBaseUrl, auth_type AS authType, credential_ref AS credentialRef, is_active AS active FROM dpm_environment WHERE id = #{environmentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cycle_no), 0) + 1 FROM dpm_test_cycle WHERE version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_test_cycle (version_id, cycle_no, cycle_name, cycle_stage, environment_id, environment_snapshot, code_version, git_branch, git_commit, build_no, scope_json, status, description, created_by) VALUES (#{request.versionId}, #{cycleNo}, #{request.cycleName}, #{request.cycleStage}, #{request.environmentId}, CAST(#{environmentSnapshotJson} AS JSON), #{request.codeVersion}, #{request.gitBranch}, #{request.gitCommit}, #{request.buildNo},
CAST(#{scopeJson} AS JSON) NULL , 'PLANNED', #{request.description}, #{request.createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_test_cycle SET cycle_name = #{request.cycleName}, cycle_stage = #{request.cycleStage}, environment_id = #{request.environmentId}, environment_snapshot = CAST(#{environmentSnapshotJson} AS JSON), code_version = #{request.codeVersion}, git_branch = #{request.gitBranch}, git_commit = #{request.gitCommit}, build_no = #{request.buildNo}, scope_json = CAST(#{scopeJson} AS JSON) NULL , description = #{request.description} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_cycle_case WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), -1) + 1 FROM dpm_cycle_case WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_cycle_case WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND test_case_id = #{caseId}
SELECT id FROM dpm_cycle_case WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND test_case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_cycle_case (cycle_id, test_case_id, test_case_revision_id, case_snapshot, execution_mode, sequence_no) VALUES (#{cycleId}, #{caseId}, #{revisionId}, CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS JSON), #{executionMode}, #{sequenceNo})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS requirementId, r.requirement_no AS requirementNo, r.title, r.requirement_type AS requirementType, r.content_markdown AS contentMarkdown, r.status, r.priority, r.owner_name AS ownerName, rc.coverage_type AS coverageType, v.version_no AS versionNo, p.project_code AS projectCode, p.project_name AS projectName, d.id AS designId, d.revision_no AS designRevisionNo, d.design_type AS designType, d.title AS designTitle, d.content_markdown AS designContentMarkdown, d.status AS designStatus, d.author_name AS designAuthorName, d.created_at AS designCreatedAt FROM dpm_requirement_case rc INNER JOIN dpm_requirement r ON r.id = rc.requirement_id INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = r.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN dpm_requirement_design d ON d.id = ( SELECT d2.id FROM dpm_requirement_design d2 WHERE d2.requirement_id = r.id ORDER BY d2.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rc.test_case_id = #{caseId} AND r.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.requirement_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_cycle_case_requirement (cycle_case_id, requirement_id, coverage_type, requirement_snapshot, design_snapshot) VALUES (#{cycleCaseId}, #{requirementId}, #{coverageType}, CAST(#{requirementSnapshotJson} AS JSON),
CAST(#{designSnapshotJson} AS JSON)
NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT cc.id, cc.cycle_id AS cycleId, cc.test_case_id AS testCaseId, cc.test_case_revision_id AS testCaseRevisionId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.caseNo')) AS caseNo, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.title')) AS title, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.revisionNo')) AS UNSIGNED) AS revisionNo, cc.execution_mode AS executionMode, cc.execution_status AS executionStatus, cc.latest_result AS latestResult, cc.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, CAST(cc.case_snapshot AS CHAR) AS caseSnapshotJson FROM dpm_cycle_case cc WHERE cc.cycle_id = #{cycleId} ORDER BY cc.sequence_no, cc.id

SELECT id, requirement_id AS requirementId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(requirement_snapshot, '$.requirementNo')) AS requirementNo, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(requirement_snapshot, '$.title')) AS title, coverage_type AS coverageType, CAST(requirement_snapshot AS CHAR) AS requirementSnapshotJson, CAST(design_snapshot AS CHAR) AS designSnapshotJson FROM dpm_cycle_case_requirement WHERE cycle_case_id = #{cycleCaseId} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dpm_cycle_case WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND id = #{cycleCaseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_test_cycle SET status = #{status}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{started} THEN NOW() ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END WHERE id = #{id}
